rationale: Quinbrook identifies PurposeEnergy as the manager-level portfolio company and SAINT as one of its projects. Vermont identifies PurposeEnergy - St. Albans, LLC as permittee; company sources confirm Quinbrook-funded construction and current operation. Ben & Jerry's is a commercial customer and Leyline is a development financier, with no distinct sponsor co-owner or later equity transfer found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone SAINT PortCo record into PurposeEnergy.
Preserve PurposeEnergy-St. Albans, PurposeEnergy - St. Albans LLC, St. Albans Industrial Treatment and SAINT as facility/SPV identities.
Preserve the Vermont location, 50,000 GPD, approximately 1 MW, 20-year Standard Offer, December 2024 commercial operations and May 29, 2025 grand opening.
Treat April 12, 2023 as the PurposeEnergy platform acquisition announcement rather than a separately proven legal close.
Exclude Ben & Jerry's, Unilever, Leyline, land/utility parties and tax-credit counterparties from equity ownership absent direct evidence.
unresolvedQuestions: The PurposeEnergy acquisition close date, sellers, stake and holdco are not publicly disclosed.
The project-LLC membership chain and any ITC legal interest are not publicly disclosed.
Leyline repayment terms are not publicly disclosed.
fieldCorrections: Do not represent the platform announcement as a separately proven legal close.
Do not treat development financing or tax-credit monetization as equity without ownership evidence.
